limitations.quote: Publish the Gray encoding on the same edge that advances the RAM pointer.
limitations.note: The agent registered the write-side Gray pointer, but also switched both sides to next-pointer encoding and gated RAM enables during reset, changing observable flag timing and reset behavior that the reference preserves.
The scoreboard used the DUT's own flags to decide which transfers counted and checked eventual boundary conditions, so it could pass without detecting the cycle-by-cycle flag timing mismatch.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the tool to reject the entire verification command before simulation, forcing the agent to resubmit the long command with a different cleanup method.
